_meta.purpose: Optional presentation fields for /card-design-gallery. Merge these objects over canonical STS_CARDS_DB (sts-planner-reworked) by matching card name (same top-level keys). Empty objects can be omitted in consumer code.

icons.CONDITIONAL_MARKER: Effect is conditional (paired with draw, energy, etc.)
icons.ANY_ORB: Generic orb placeholder when color not fixed
icons.SAME_ORB_AS_EVOKED: Echo orb type from prior evoke
icons.AOE_ICON: Hits all enemies (paired with damage icon)

fieldKeys.draw: base/upgraded counts; conditioned + trigger when draw depends on If/Whenever (icons applied at render time).
fieldKeys.discardEffect: Flat: base, upgraded, random, fromHand — no icon keys; UI maps discard to DISCARD_ICON.
fieldKeys.orbInteractions: Ordered verbs: channel/evoke/next/repeat; orbIcon + presentation only (no usesIcon).
fieldKeys.multiHit: damageUsesMainField binds to STS damage; multiHitCount for numeric repeat 4 upgraded 5.
fieldKeys.multiHitCount: base upgraded when fixed repeat count; Skewer uses multiHitEnergyScaling instead.
fieldKeys.multiHitPresentation: formulaPresentation template text for [DMG] times X vs times hit count.
fieldKeys.selfExhaustOnPlay: Per tier: base and upgraded booleans — whether playing that copy exhausts the card.
fieldKeys.appliesDebuffs: vulnerable, weak, poison etc. with base/upgraded stacks.
